decision.independentProposals: Both recommend reuse of the existing owner/attempt/navigation guarded hook and first enabled checkbox without selection. Steve initially stable aria-disabled button; Elena initially detach and status.
decision.challenge: Steve preferred detached status after exchange. Elena accepted stable aria-disabled with guarded handler and visible busy state.
decision.rootDecision: Retain stable busy button, matching NewsRecoveryNotice and avoiding layout/focus loss. Shared useRetryFocus untouched. Steve alternative is a reversible presentation preference, not a blocking defect.
decision.review: Elena found busy CSS overrode transform while global press uses translate. Corrected to translate:0 0, rebuilt and natively sampled held active busy button at0px. No ref/operation issue found.
